verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an IDE review surface for VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and any VS Code-based IDE. It reviews uncommitted changes as you code, with no pull request required, before you push, and lets you apply fixes instantly. The pricing page lists agentic reviews across PR, CLI, and IDE. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the IDE extension, explicit documentation that the IDE review matches the PR review in depth and config, support beyond VS Code-based editors (e.g., JetBrains).
